description: If you find yourself wearing the same shirt, tie, and shoes with the same suit every week, it's time you should check out Barker. With a partiality towards colours, clean stripes and luxurious fabrics, choose from a range of shirts, suits and shoes that will get you more mileage (and style) out of yourself.

Whether you’re grabbing a quick bite or enjoying a meal with loved ones, Popeyes delivers a comforting and unforgettable dining experience.

description: THREEPPY is a new concept store operated by DAISO Japan since 2018. You can ﬁnd a variety of cute and fashionable items. With our wide variety of products, we brighten our customers’ lives with good quality and affordable products from Japan. Happy Price, Happy Place, Happy People.

name: Timezone
description: Visit Timezone website for details. Timezone is the world's leading fun family interactive entertainment centre with state-of-the-art games and a wide variety of attractive prizes. Timezone games come from world-class amusement brands such as Sega, Banda Namco and LAI to name a few. Our best-in-class store design and well trained FunSquad guarantees a fun-filled experience for both the young and the young-at-heart.

name: TRT
description: TRT, a Singaporean label, offers sustainable, modular fashion for men, women, and kids, focusing on timeless, versatile designs and creative self-expression.

name: Turtle
description: Turtle is an innovative novelty gift and lifestyle shop. One can find a range of unique and quirky stationery, plushies, onesies, toys, gadgets, party supplies, beauty products, home decorations and lifestyle indulgences here at our Marina Square Outlet!

name: urban de.Fine
description: urban de.Fine sources for the most unique and high quality executive lifestyle products within and out of The Little Red Dot. Each brand's emergence has a story behind and urban de.Fine aims to bring our customers inspirations and motivations from these brand owners. urban de.Fine is a multi-label concept store that defines your individuality.

name: Victoria Bakery & Cafe
description: A premium Hong Kong-inspired bakery which marries elements of a classic Hong Kong tea house with modern touches through the use of premium ingredients. Victoria Bakery’s pastries are made using traditional baking techniques and updated with modern and innovative flavours, boasting a laid-back atmosphere where customers are able to enjoy light bites, freshly baked goods and freshly-ground artisanal coffee.

name: Vincitore The Italian Shoe Store
description: At Vincitore, their collection of handmade shoes embodies the fine craftmanship of master Italian shoemakers. Each exquisite pair of shoes espouses the intricacy of meticulous Italian craftsmanship, elaborately designed to augment your polished wardrobe.

name: Vispring
description: A perfectly & indulgence sleep

name: Vroomtown Driving City
description: VroomTown features multiple Singapore icons including the Merlion, Gardens by the Bay and Changi Airport! The realistic driving experience also includes traffic lights & signs, a playground and a drive-through for kids!

name: W Optics
description: Home-grown vision care centre providing eyecare solutions, optical products, such as prescriptive lenses, night lenses, contact lenses, and eye examinations catering to specific needs of customers. Eye examinations are tailored to individual needs by age group, necessary for all in this digital age to screen for different eye conditions or eye diseases. Specialize in Myopia management in children. W OPTICS at Marina Sqaure is a Myopia Centre.

name: Watsons
description: Singapore’s Leading Health & Beauty Retailer - Watsons is Asia’s No. 1 Personal Care and Beauty Offline + Online Retailer, with close to 100 stores islandwide and the flagship health and beauty brand of the A.S. Watson Group. It continually sets the standard in heath, wellness, and beauty by providing personalized and related advice and counselling to customers and a market-leading product range in their offering, so that they can ‘LOOK GOOD, DO GOOD, FEEL GREAT’ every day. Other accolades and awards received include Omnichannel Strategy of the Year 2023 – Singapore and Health & Beauty Retailer of the Year – Singapore consecutively from 2021 – 2023 by Retail Asia Awards and ‘Best HR Digital Transformation Strategy’ at the prestigious Employee Experience Awards 2023. Watsons accepts NETS, DBS PAYLAH!, VISA, MASTERCARD, AMERICAN EXPRESS, JCB, DINERS CLUB INTERNATIONAL, UNIONPAY.

name: West Coast Dental Clinic
description: West Coast Dental Clinic provides family dentistry in a clean, pleasant, and relaxing environment. Fully equipped to render a full range of dental services including braces, root canal, wisdom tooth and dental implants. Medisave claimable. Dr. Arthur Lim is friendly, gentle and has more than 20 years of experience in treating patients from many different countries.

name: XTRA
description: XTRA is a premium design store in Singapore founded since 1989. Originally sited in a pre-war conservation shophouse in the east, we started as an alternative eclectic design store but have since evolved into a mainstream store with a carefully curated range of global design products for both the residential and contract market.

name: Xtra Office
description: As a separate independent entity, XTRA OFFICE is specialized as the sole authorized dealer of Herman Miller in offering total solutions to the modern office in Singapore and through TRAX FURNITURE SDN BHD in Malaysia. With the intuitive knowledge of the modern working environment we provide holistic solutions that incorporate collaborations, interactions and engagements in and beyond the personal workspace.

name: Ya Kun Kaya Toast
description: From its humble beginnings as a modest coffee stall in the 1940s, the name of Ya Kun has become synonymous with unparalleled kaya toast and irresistibly fragrant coffee and tea, enjoyed amidst a cosy atmosphere. Today, Ya Kun continues to delight fans and to attract converts.

name: YangGuoFu Malatang
description: Yang Guo Fu is the world’s largest Mala Tang Chain known to have over 6000 franchise stores around the world, with restaurants in Japan, Korea, Canada and Singapore. They are known for their signature Spicy Mala Beef Broth, Tomato Broth and Mala dry.

name: Yechun Xiao Jiang Nan @ The Dining Edition
description: Yechun Xiao Jiang Nan is specialized in Jiang Nan cuisine as the name suggests, as well as Lanzhou Ramen (hand-pulled noodles). It is also the first and only Chinese restaurant that offers healthy multi-grain food in Singapore. The interior design of the restaurant is Jiang Nan style with an open kitchen, where guests could see how the Ramen and the Shanshui beancurd are made in house. Yechun Xiao Jiang Nan believes in serving guests with heartily delicious food and heartily sincere service, in the hope to bring a green and healthy dining experience to all diners.

name: Yi Zun Noodle
description: Yi Zun Noodle is Singapore’s first ever muslim-owned restaurant that specialises in Chinese hand-pulled noodles. Founded by Madam Aisha, a Chinese-muslim from Qinghai in China, Yi Zun Noodle began as her simple dream to let fellow friends in Singapore taste authentic halal Chinese cuisine at an affordable price.

name: YouClass Learning Centre
description: As Singapore’s leading training centre for all students, YouClass provides a wide range of academic and enrichment courses. At YouClass, every curriculum is carefully crafted to ignite students’ passion and interest in the undertaken subject.
